summary: The filing is a routine Form 8-K filed by Structured Obligations Corporation as registrant for the Select Notes Trust LT 2003-1, an asset-backed security trust. It reports a scheduled interest distribution to certificate holders on June 15, 2026, providing the interest amount received ($295,625) and per-certificate income ($5.653) for Form 1099 purposes. The filing includes a trustee report and disclaims any due diligence on issuers of underlying securities. There are no merger, acquisition, restructuring, or other special-situation elements. This is a periodic operational update, not a special situation.
